risk.title: Risk Control
risk.description: Audit user text before forwarding. Account settings take precedence over global policy.
risk.mode_help: Observe still waits for the audit result but allows requests. Pre-block returns 403 on a hit.
risk.scope_help: Only user text is checked. System instructions, tool results, and media are excluded; a text check does not establish media safety.
risk.models_help: One per line. Exact match against the model name requested by the client.
risk.rules_help: Keywords ignore case; regex uses Go RE2 syntax. Any match triggers the policy. Up to 100 rules.
risk.failure_help: Applies to timeouts, API errors, oversized or unsupported input. Observe mode always allows.
risk.excerpt_help: Off by default. Stores up to 240 characters with keys, tokens, emails and phone numbers masked. Other sensitive content may remain.
risk.account_help: Inherit, disable, or customize. Custom policies share the audit API configured in Risk Control.
risk.api_help: OpenAI Moderations compatible endpoint. API checks send selected user text to this service. Local hits are not sent.
risk.api_key_help: Set this variable in the CPA process environment and restart CPA after environment changes. Enter only its name; leave blank for an unauthenticated local service.
risk.key_ready: The saved configuration references an environment variable that is set.
risk.key_missing: No usable key is referenced by the saved configuration. An unauthenticated local service does not need one.
risk.thresholds_help: One category=0.8 per line, from 0 to 1. Empty uses the service decision. Unlisted categories retain service decisions. Missing configured scores are audit errors.
risk.threshold_invalid: Use category=0.8, with unique categories and values between 0 and 1.
risk.changed: Content audit configuration changed elsewhere. Refresh before retrying.
risk.test_help: Uses the current draft without saving, logging or sending an inference request. API mode calls the audit service.
risk.records_help: Records hits, audit errors and requests containing unaudited media. Retained for 30 days, up to 10,000 records. Policy tests are not stored.
risk.media_ignored: Only text was checked. Included images, audio or files were not audited.
risk.reason_policy_not_applicable: Policy is off or the model is outside its scope.
risk.reason_media_only: Media-only input cannot be checked by text moderation.
risk.reason_body_too_large: Request body exceeds 4 MiB; no truncated audit was performed.
risk.reason_text_too_large: User text exceeds 64,000 characters; no truncated audit was performed.
risk.reason_invalid_body: Could not parse the request body.
risk.reason_unsupported_format: Content audit does not support this request format.
risk.reason_api_key_missing: Audit API key environment variable is not set.
risk.reason_api_request_invalid: Audit API request configuration is invalid.
risk.reason_api_timeout_or_canceled: Audit timed out or the request was canceled.
risk.reason_api_http_error: Audit service returned an unsuccessful status.
risk.reason_api_response_invalid: Audit service returned an invalid response.
risk.reason_api_category_missing: Audit response is missing valid category scores.
risk.reason_api_categories_missing: Audit response is missing category decisions.
risk.reason_credential_unresolved: The host did not identify the selected account; its policy cannot be resolved.
risk.reason_record_unavailable: Audit record could not be saved.
